study_identification_part.si_3_author_journal_year: Oliveira-Saraiva and Ferreira, Frontiers in Psychiatry, 2023
study_identification_part.si_4_title: Normative model detects abnormal functional connectivity in psychiatric disorders

dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.detail: FCON refers to the Consortium for Reliability and Reproducibility (CoRR) database, which is part of the 1000 Functional Connectomes Project. Nine CoRR sub-datasets were used: BNU3 (H-48), HNU1 (H-30), IPCAS1 (H-30), IPCAS3 (H-34), IPCAS4 (H-20), MRN1 (H-39), NYU2 (H-81), Utah1 (H-16), Utah2 (H-1). CNP refers to the UCLA Consortium for Neuropsychiatric Phenomics LA5c Study, which included H-130, ADHD-43, BD-49, SCZ-50. COBRE included H-74 and SCZ-55.
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.supporting_text: "The Consortium for Reliability and Reproducibility (CoRR) public database (36) was chosen because it contains a large number of different datasets with data from healthy subjects" ... "The UCLA Consortium for Neuropsychiatric Phenomics LA5c Study (UCLA) public dataset (37) was selected to train and test the normative model since it contains healthy individuals and ADHD, BD, and SCZ patients. The Center for Biomedical Research Excellence (COBRE) public dataset (38-41), which is composed of healthy individuals and SCZ patients, was also chosen to evaluate the performance of the trained model on an independent dataset."
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.location: OliveiraSaraiva2023.pdf.md: 2. Materials and methods / 2.1. Data description, L81; Table 1, L91-L107

answer.FCON: normative training (healthy controls from CoRR sub-datasets contributed to H-Train)

answer.CNP: normative training and testing; clinical testing (healthy controls split into H-Train and H-Test-U; ADHD, BD, and SCZ patients used as clinical test sets)

answer.COBRE: independent testing (H-Test-C and SCZ-Test-C for evaluating generalization)

dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.detail: CoRR healthy subjects were part of the H-Train set (366 healthy subjects from CoRR and UCLA combined). UCLA healthy subjects were split into H-Train and H-Test-U (39 subjects). UCLA patients formed three clinical test sets: SCZ-Test-U (47), BD-Test-U (45), ADHD-Test-U (39). COBRE subjects formed two independent test sets: H-Test-C (70 healthy) and SCZ-Test-C (49 SCZ patients).
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.supporting_text: "H-Train represents the 366 healthy subjects from CORR and UCLA datasets that were used to train the model. H-Test-U is the set of 39 healthy subjects from the UCLA dataset that were used to test the model. SCZ-Test-U, BD-Test-U, and ADHD-Test-U are the sets of psychiatric patients ... H-Test-C and SCZ-Test-C are the independent test sets consisting of 70 healthy subjects, and 49 SCZ patients from the COBRE dataset, respectively."

dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.detail: One normative model was built using an autoencoder architecture. The overall-phase HC count includes H-Train (366 from CoRR+UCLA), H-Test-U (39 from UCLA), and H-Test-C (70 from COBRE), totaling 475. The train-phase used 366 healthy subjects. Note: 655 subjects continued to analysis after motion exclusion (from initial 700), and the final split yielded 366 for training.
dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.supporting_text: "H-Train represents the 366 healthy subjects from CORR and UCLA datasets that were used to train the model. H-Test-U is the set of 39 healthy subjects from the UCLA dataset ... H-Test-C and SCZ-Test-C are the independent test sets consisting of 70 healthy subjects, and 49 SCZ patients from the COBRE dataset"

dc_4_age_info_of_each_normative_nodel.detail: Overall-phase weighted mean was computed from H-Train (N=366, mean=26), H-Test-U (N=39, mean=34), and H-Test-C (N=70, mean=35): (366*26 + 39*34 + 70*35) / 475 = 13292 / 475 = 27.98. Overall min/max derived from Table 2 age ranges (H-Train 18-49, H-Test-U 21-50, H-Test-C 18-50), yielding min=18, max=50. Train-phase values directly from Table 2 (H-Train row). SD, median, and IQR are not reported.
dc_4_age_info_of_each_normative_nodel.supporting_text: "H-Train ... Age range 18-49, Age mean 26" ... "H-Test-U ... Age range 21-50, Age mean 34" ... "H-Test-C ... Age range 18-50, Age mean 35"

dc_5_sex_info_of_each_normative_nodel.detail: Female percentages are reported in Table 2. Train-phase: H-Train N=366, 47% female -> 172 female, 194 male. Overall-phase inferred from H-Train (366, 47% female -> 172F), H-Test-U (39, 51% female -> 20F), H-Test-C (70, 30% female -> 21F). Total female = 172+20+21 = 213 out of 475 = 44.8%. Male = 475-213 = 262 = 55.2%. Rounding: H-Train 366*0.47=171.98~172; H-Test-U 39*0.51=19.89~20; H-Test-C 70*0.30=21.
